snippet.title: A Chinese-style gangster story? *DONGDA Gangster* is coming to console platforms this month.
snippet.description: Based on the best-selling novel Northeast Past. Set in the chaotic streets of 1980s Northeast China, where the old order is crumbling. In a brutal underworld of brotherhood and betrayal, your choices will rewrite fate. A cinematic live-action interactive experience.
